Plan: Audio demodulation and playback¶

Branch: 7-audio-demod (from main at b50b762) Status: implemented in the branch (uncommitted). Decisions are in section 6, test results and remaining work in section 7.

1. Goal¶

Add an Audio window that demodulates one channel and plays it to the speakers:

  • File mode: play a recording from a cursor, the current view, or the marked time range, with a playhead that follows on the plots.

  • Live mode: play the device stream as it arrives (RTL-SDR, USRP, sim, or siggen loopback). Playback runs alongside recording.

Out of scope for now: FM stereo / RDS, more than one channel at a time, network audio output.

2. Starting point¶

Area

What exists

Gap

Demodulation

computeDemod() (src/dsp/engine.cpp) — batch per view, cancellable, reduced for display

No demodulator that keeps filter / phase state across blocks, so no continuous audio

Live samples

SampleRing (src/common/sample_ring.h) supports extra lossy readers with their own cursor

LiveEngine does not expose ring_, the format, or the rate

Tuning

demod_.chanEnable/chanOffset/chanBw and the drag overlay, file mode only

Live mode is spectrum-only and has no tuner overlay

Tool windows

drawSigGenWindow() + drawSigGenButton()

Pattern to copy for a floating window and toolbar button

Audio output

None — the build links only X11, GL, and threads

Needs an output backend

3. Design decisions¶

Topic

Decision

Reason

Audio output

Vendor miniaudio (single header, public domain / MIT-0) in third_party/

CoreAudio on macOS; ALSA / PulseAudio / PipeWire on Linux, loaded at runtime, so no new build dependency. Matches the vendored ImGui / ImPlot approach

Build switch

WVT_WITH_AUDIO = AUTO / ON / OFF, defines WVT_HAVE_AUDIO

Same pattern as WVT_WITH_RTLSDR / WVT_WITH_UHD. With it off, WAV export still works

DSP

New stateful, block-based AudioDemod (src/audio/audio_dsp.*)

Keeps computeDemod and the viewer unchanged

Channelizer

NCO shift → cascade of half-band decimators → final FIR to the IF rate

A single direct FIR (as in computeDemod) is too costly in real time at 10–20 MS/s

Modes

AM, NFM, WFM (mono, 50 / 75 µs de-emphasis), USB, LSB, CW (BFO)

Covers the sim stations and common bands

Resampling

Polyphase / Farrow resampler with a variable ratio, to 48 kHz

Device and file rates are arbitrary

Clock drift (live)

PI loop on the audio ring fill level trims the resampler ratio (about ±500 ppm)

SDR and sound card clocks differ; without this, audio underruns or builds up delay

Threading

One DSP thread per audio session fills an SPSC float ring. The miniaudio callback only copies out (no locks, no allocation) and plays zeros on underrun

Keeps the audio callback real-time safe

Tuning

“Follow viewer channel” (default on) uses the existing channel offset / bandwidth; off gives the pane its own settings

One tuner instead of two that disagree

Window

Floating ImGui window “Audio”, toolbar button and shortcut

Same as the Signal Generator

Live retune / gap

When LiveEngine gen_ changes or the reader is lapped, reset the demod state and resync near written()

Avoids glitches and stale audio

4. Work breakdown¶

Phase 1 — Build and output backend¶

  • [x] Vendor third_party/miniaudio/miniaudio.h; one src/audio/audio_out.cpp with MINIAUDIO_IMPLEMENTATION.

  • [x] src/audio/audio_out.h: AudioOut — open / close, device list, 48 kHz stereo float, pull from the SPSC ring, underrun counter, latency.

  • [x] CMake: WVT_WITH_AUDIO; link CoreAudio / AudioToolbox / CoreFoundation on macOS, dl / m on Linux.

  • [x] --list-audio-devices.

  • [x] Confirm early that audio plays from the XQuartz-linked binary on macOS.

Phase 2 — Streaming DSP (src/audio_dsp.{h,cpp})¶

  • [x] Nco, HalfbandDecim, FirDecim (with saved history), Resampler (variable ratio), DcBlock, Agc, Deemphasis.

  • [x] AudioDemod::process(const cf* in, int64_t n, std::vector<float>& out), configured by AudioParams (mode, offset, bw, squelch dB, AGC, de-emphasis, volume, BFO).

  • [x] Reuse designLowpass() and getFFT() from dsp.h.

Phase 3 — Audio engine (src/audio_engine.{h,cpp})¶

  • [x] AudioEngine with one small source interface and two implementations:

    • FileAudioSource: IqFile + FormatParams, sample cursor, range [s0, s1], loop, seek, pause; reads ahead in ~20 ms blocks.

    • LiveAudioSource: lossy SampleRing::read() with its own cursor, starting ~100 ms behind written(); resyncs when lapped.

  • [x] Drift PI loop (live mode only; files have no drift).

  • [x] Stats for the UI: playhead, level (dBFS), underruns, resyncs, latency, squelch state.

  • [x] LiveEngine: add ring(), format(), rate(), gen() accessors.

Phase 4 — UI (src/app/app_audio.cpp, members in src/app/app.h)¶

  • [x] Toolbar button “Audio” (* while playing) and Ctrl+D (Ctrl+A would conflict with select-all in text fields).

  • [x] Window contents:

    • Source: File or Live, from the app mode.

    • Tuning: follow channel, offset, bandwidth.

    • Demod: mode, AGC, de-emphasis, BFO, squelch.

    • Output: device combo, volume, mute, level meter.

    • Transport (file): play / pause / stop, range (cursor / view / markers / whole file), loop, position slider.

    • Status line: latency, underruns, resyncs.

  • [x] File mode: playhead line on the time plots and waterfall; modifier-click on a time plot seeks; optional “follow playhead” pans the view.

  • [x] Live mode: channel overlay on the live spectrum and waterfall (drag line, shaded bandwidth) and click-to-tune, using the same demod_.chanOffset.

  • [x] Stop audio when the source changes (open file, enter / leave live mode, device stop).

Phase 5 — WAV export and CLI¶

  • [x] “Save WAV…” for the selected file range, faster than real time; “Record audio” toggle in live mode.

  • [x] --audio MODE, --audio-out FILE.wav (demodulate the file or --view range and exit, like --gen-out), --audio-device NAME, --volume DB.

Phase 6 — Tests and docs¶

  • [x] tools/audio_check.cpp (like siggen_check): synthesize AM / FM / SSB tones at a known offset, run AudioDemod, check tone frequency, SNR, and level; check resampler output length against the ratio; check that the drift loop converges for a ±200 ppm rate error.

  • [x] Manual checks: wvt --device sim (built-in AM and FM stations) and iqgen files.

  • [x] README: Audio section, build option, CLI flags, source-file table.

  • [ ] Roadmap row (left for you: the table numbers versions, and 1.2 / 1.3 are not done yet).

5. Risks¶

Risk

Mitigation

macOS audio from an XQuartz-linked process

CoreAudio works from any process; verify in Phase 1

No audio device (ssh -X, Xvfb, headless)

Pane shows “no output device; WAV export only” and keeps working

High rates (USRP at 20+ MS/s)

Measure the half-band cascade; show “DSP behind” in the status line if it cannot keep up

Live latency vs. robustness

~150 ms target (100 ms for files); not adjustable yet

6. Decisions (formerly open questions)¶

Question

Decision

Output backend

Vendor miniaudio

Window

Floating window, like the Signal Generator

Modes

AM, NFM, WFM (mono), USB, LSB, CW, as listed. WFM stereo is out of scope for this branch

WAV export

In this version: “Save WAV…”, live “Record audio”, and headless --audio-out

7. Results and remaining work¶

Implemented as planned, with these details:

  • Files: src/audio/audio_dsp.*, src/audio/audio_engine.*, src/audio/audio_out.*, src/io/wav_writer.*, src/audio/miniaudio_impl.c, src/app/app_audio.cpp, tools/audio_check.cpp, third_party/miniaudio/ (0.11.25, header + license). Small changes in app.*, app_live.cpp, live.h, main.cpp, recorder.* (exports makeDirs), CMakeLists.txt, README.md.

  • miniaudio on macOS uses MA_NO_RUNTIME_LINKING and links the CoreAudio frameworks; on Linux it loads the backends at run time (links only dl, m, threads). The MA_NO_* defines are on the miniaudio target as PUBLIC, so all files see the same configuration.

  • For every mode, offset is the passband center, so the cyan / orange overlay is exactly the passband. USB puts the carrier at the lower edge, LSB at the upper edge.

  • “Follow playhead” only pages views of 0.25 s or more; shorter views paged faster than the plots could be computed.

  • Headless --audio-out with --device records live audio without opening a sound device (AudioOutput::None).

  • App::busy() does not include audio; App::audioBusy() keeps the main loop running. This keeps --screenshot working while audio plays.

Verified:

  • build/audio_check: all modes at 250 kS/s, 2.4 MS/s and 10 MS/s with blocks of random size. Tone within 1 Hz, SNR 37-70 dB, output length within 0.15 %, ratio trim exact (+500 ppm), squelch, and the WAV header. DSP speed at 10 MS/s: 10-15x real time (x86_64 build under Rosetta).

  • Headless export from an iqgen file (WFM 1 kHz at 53 dB SNR; AM 400 Hz) and headless live recording from --device sim (WFM 50 dB, AM 400 Hz, 0 resyncs).

  • 40 s live run against the MacBook speakers (muted): latency steady at 173-180 ms, drift trim -90 to -290 ppm, 0 underruns, 0 resyncs, DSP load 11-13 % for WFM at 2.4 MS/s.

  • Screenshots of file playback (playhead, level meter, follow) and live playback (tuner overlay).

  • Build with -DWVT_WITH_AUDIO=OFF: compiles, reports “built without audio output”, WAV export works.

Checked by hand: playback with the simulator and with a handheld radio.

Not yet verified by hand:

  • [ ] Listening test of each mode.

  • [ ] Shift+click to play, dragging the playhead and the position slider, Pause / Resume, Loop.

  • [ ] Live “Record audio” button, device combo, audio across a retune and a stream restart.

  • [ ] Real RTL-SDR / USRP streams (only the simulator was tested).

  • [ ] A Linux build (only macOS was built here).

Possible follow-ups: adjustable live latency, FM stereo, audio spectrum / scope in the window.
